signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story gray-sided colonial with a red front door, attached garage, and front lawn. Some tree foliage partially obscures the left side and roof.
signals.notes: A white SUV is in the driveway by the garage; the lawn is green and tidy with mulched beds and mature trees, and chairs are set out on the front porch, suggesting an occupied, well-kept home.
